Mosaic Events Bengaluru is bookable by purchasing agents.

If you have this origin open in a WebMCP-capable browser (ChatGPT desktop in-app browser), use the site tools on the page. Do not invent HTTP GET or POST. Do not ask the human for an API token.

Site tools: get_merchant_profile, search_venue_services, request_quote, continue_rfq, get_rfq, revise_quote, accept_quote, create_checkout, get_transaction_status.

The tab keeps the ticket after request_quote. Later tools send it. After create_checkout, give the human checkout_url. Card details stay on Razorpay.

Fallback for agents that cannot use WebMCP: POST a natural-language brief to /api/enquire as JSON { "request": "..." }. Keep the ticket. Send it as header X-Mosaic-Ticket or JSON { "ticket": "..." }.

Machine contract: /.well-known/agent-commerce.json
Optional remote MCP: /api/mcp
